entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Donbeeni. N lee sɛɛra bio Un lera mi yi, á nan zun-wo, à loo ɓaani-wo. N ta n bidamu le wo paanka boo han laana waan, án loo mun ta n khemu le wo paanmamu boo.
Donbeeni bwin binnian mían ka mu yinan Wote, Yan na yii fueni mu bosoa yi, Yan na wi mí hakuru yere paanka kasi yi.
